result.title: Silicone hydrogel lens with crosslinked coating (amended)

canonical_claim.raw_claim_text: 1. A coated silicone hydrogel contact lens, comprising: a silicone hydrogel contact lens and a non-silicone hydrogel coating thereon, wherein the non-silicone hydrogel coating is composed of a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material which comprises from about 20% to about 95% by weight of first polymer chains derived from a multi-arm polyethyleneglycol having terminal epoxide groups and from about 5% to about 80% by weight of a second polymer chains derived from at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent, wherein said at least one hydrophilicity-enhancing agent is selected from the group consisting of: PEG-NH 2 ; PEG-SH; PEG-COOH; H 2 N-PEG-NH 2 ; HOOC-PEG-COOH; HS-PEG-SH; H 2 N-PEG-COOH; HOOC-PEG-SH; H 2 N-PEG-SH: multi-arm PEG with at least one amino group; multi-arm PEG with at least one carboxyl group; multi-arm PEG with at least one thiol group; PEG dendrimers with at least one amino group; PEG dendrimers with at least one carboxyl group; PEG dendrimers with at least one thiol group; and combinations thereof, wherein the coated silicone hydrogel contact lens has at least one of the properties selected from the group consisting of: an oxygen permeability of at least about 40 barrers; an elastic modulus of about 1.5 MPa or less; an Ionoflux Diffusion Coefficient, D, of, at least about 1.5×10 −6 mm 2 /min; a water content of from about 18% to about 70% by weight when fully hydrated; or combinations thereof. || 2. novelty_results.rationale: The prior-art patent discloses a coated silicone hydrogel contact lens with a crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material, but it does not specify the exact composition of the second polymer chains. Additionally, it does not disclose the specific properties of the coated lens, such as oxygen permeability, elastic modulus, or Ionoflux Diffusion Coefficient. Furthermore, the arrangement of the coating on the silicone hydrogel contact lens is not disclosed.

obviousness_result.closest_prior_art_rationale: Selected as closest because it discloses the most limitations (2/5) and is in a similar technical field (Contact Lens).
obviousness_result.objective_technical_problem: A contact lens that addresses the limitations of existing designs, specifically improving the comfort and stability of the lens on the eye, as described in US11747519B2, which lacks a mechanism to prevent the lens from rotating or tilting excessively, and a method to enhance the wearer's experience.
distinguishing_features: The crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material comprises from about 35% to about 90% by weight of the first polymer chains and from about 10% to about 65% by weight of the second polymer chains.
The crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material comprises from about 50% to about 85% by weight of the first polymer chains and from about 15% to 50% by weight of the second polymer chains.
obviousness_result.technical_effect: Improving the comfort and stability of the contact lens on the eye, and enhancing the wearer's experience.
obviousness_result.motivation: To address the limitations of existing contact lens designs and provide a more comfortable and stable wearing experience.
obviousness_result.why_explanation: The claimed invention provides a specific range of compositions for the crosslinked hydrophilic polymeric material, which could be considered a feasible combination of known elements. However, the motivation behind the claimed invention is not clearly linked to the objective technical problem, and the technical effect is not directly related to the comfort and stability of the lens. Therefore, it is unlikely that the PSA would have done it.
